title: Piano Quartet in E Minor
description: A reflective arrangement of the traditional farewell song.

title: Amazing Grace (Full Score)
description: An extended chamber work for piano and strings.
lyrics:
Amazing Grace
Should auld acquaintance be forgot
And never brought to mind?
Should auld acquaintance be forgot
For auld lang syne?

Amazing grace, how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me
I once was lost, but now I'm found
Was blind, but now I see

'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear
And grace, my fears relieved
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed

Ahumawe, ahumawe!
Ahumawe, ahumawe! (repeatedly)
Uloyiko lwam luphelile
Ahumawe, ahumawe!
Ahumawe, ahumawe! (repeatedly)
Bambelela, alebamba!

Through many dangers, toils and snares
We have already come
'Twas grace that brought us safe thus far
And grace will lead us home

Ubabalo lwakho, ubabalo lwakho
Lundifumene, lwandisindisa!
Ubabalo lwakho, ubabalo lwakho
Ngoku ndivuma lwakho, eh!
Ngoba ndikhokhelwa lwakho
Luzandifikisa, luzandifikisa
Hmm! Ekhaya!

For auld lang syne, my dear
For auld lang syne 
We’ll take a cup of kindness yet
For auld lang syne

When we've been there ten thousand years
Bright shining as the sun
We've no less days to sing God's praise
Than when we first begun
Than when we first begun

Hum: (Ooo   Loo)

Alleluia, alleluia, amen! (repeatedly)
I once was lost but am found, amen
Alleluia, alleluia, amen! (repeatedly)

title: The Parting Glass
description: A contemporary arrangement of the classic hymn arranged by Emmanuel O. Solomon.
lyrics:
Parting Glass
Oh of all the money that ere I spent,
I have spent it in good company.
And of all the harm I’ve ever done,
Alas! It was to none but me.
And all I’ve done for want of wit
To mem’ry now I can’t recall 
So fill to me the parting glass,
Good night and joy be with you all,
With you all, hey!

If I had money enough to spend,
And leisure time to sit awhile,
There is a fair maiden in this town
Who sorely has my heart beguiled.
Her rosy cheeks and ruby lips,


I own she has my heart in thrall.
So, fill to me the parting glass
Good night and joy be with you.

Slàinte Mhath! Aye!
